comparisons.name: finder-search-light
comparisons.description: The leading end of Finder's scope bar, Aqua: label, a scope that is off and the one that is on. Whole crop, text included.

comparisons.name: finder-search-light-drawing
comparisons.description: As finder-search-light with the three texts masked (they are set in the fallback font off Apple platforms), to score the bar, its separator rows and the pill.

comparisons.name: finder-search-dark
comparisons.description: The leading end of Finder's scope bar, Dark Aqua. Whole crop, text included.

comparisons.name: finder-search-dark-drawing
comparisons.description: As finder-search-dark with the three texts masked, to score the bar, its separator rows and the pill.

comparisons.name: finder-search-actions-light
comparisons.description: The trailing end of Finder's scope bar, Aqua: the round-rect Save and + buttons. Whole crop, the title included.

comparisons.name: finder-search-actions-light-drawing
comparisons.description: As finder-search-actions-light with the title of Save masked, to score the borders, the corners and the + glyph.

comparisons.name: finder-search-actions-dark
comparisons.description: The trailing end of Finder's scope bar, Dark Aqua: the round-rect Save and + buttons. Whole crop, the title included.

comparisons.name: finder-search-actions-dark-drawing
comparisons.description: As finder-search-actions-dark with the title of Save masked, to score the borders, the corners and the + glyph.

comparisons.name: preview-find-light
comparisons.description: The leading end of Preview's find bar (toolbar surface), Aqua: the blue label, a scope that is off and the one that is on. Whole crop, text included.

comparisons.name: preview-find-light-drawing
comparisons.description: As preview-find-light with the three texts masked, to score the gradient, the separator rows and the pill.

comparisons.name: preview-find-dark
comparisons.description: The first 134 pt of Preview's find bar, Dark Aqua, where it lies over the sidebar: the label and the start of the scope that is off. Further right the bar is lit by the page behind the window, which is not reproduced. Whole crop, text included.

comparisons.name: preview-find-dark-drawing
comparisons.description: As preview-find-dark with the texts masked, to score the gradient and the separator rows.

comparisons.name: preview-find-actions-light
comparisons.description: The trailing end of Preview's find bar, Aqua: the disabled previous and next buttons as a segmented pair, and Done. Whole crop, the title included.

comparisons.name: preview-find-actions-light-drawing
comparisons.description: As preview-find-actions-light with the title of Done and the two chevrons masked (the chevrons are original shapes, not Apple's glyphs), to score the borders, the divider and the corners.

comparisons.name: console-light
comparisons.description: The leading end of Console's scope bar, Aqua: the small bar on the toolbar surface with the scope that is on and one that is off. Whole crop, text included; the place of Console's sidebar button is empty.

comparisons.name: console-light-drawing
comparisons.description: As console-light with the sidebar button's glyph and the two titles masked, to score the 23 pt bar, its fill, its two bottom rows and the pill.

comparisons.name: console-dark
comparisons.description: The leading end of Console's scope bar, Dark Aqua. Whole crop, text included. The capture's bar is darker at its leading end than the fill measured at its middle.

comparisons.name: console-dark-drawing
comparisons.description: As console-dark with the same three regions masked.
